newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore to release third quarter data on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore to release third quarter data on Friday.

text.p: Singapore will release third quarter economic data on Friday at 8 a.m. (2400 GMT Thursday), the Ministry of Trade and Industry said on Tuesday.

Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong already announced in a speech on Tuesday that the city state's gross domestic product aPLGDP grew 3.2 percent in the third quarter and that the government was now forecasting 1996 growth at six percent, down from an earlier forecast of seven to eight percent.
The Friday release will include more details in such areas as sectoral performance, inflation, employment and productivity.
